target_language_naturalness.evidence: The Lena contact exchange and Jonas registration dialogue use idiomatic A1 German, including informal deine and formal Ihre contact questions.

persian_translation.evidence: Persian translations distinguish telephone number, origin and current residence naturally without German calques.

pos_in_context.evidence: Telefonnummer is a noun and null/eins/zwei/drei/vier/fünf are numeral entries in the exact contact-number context.

sense_example_alignment.evidence: Each number example is a usable numeral sequence and Telefonnummer appears in the taught ownership construction.

accepted_response_naturalness.evidence: All accepted learner forms are natural short or full answers suitable for A1 contact exchange and registration.

natural_story_dialogue.evidence: Lena saves Raha's number as a plausible continuation of their friendship; number drilling is moved into activities rather than repetitive story turns.

surface_variation_transfer.evidence: The target moves from Meine Telefonnummer ist... to asking deine Telefonnummer, reading digits, and providing the number to Jonas in formal registration.

learner_facing_pronunciation.evidence: Every lesson uses listen-notice-produce work on German z in zwei inside actual numeral use.

persian_speaker_contrast.evidence: The z unit explicitly contrasts German initial /ts/ with Persian ز and requires production in zwei.

novel_context_mastery.evidence: Lesson 4 removes Lena and places Raha with Jonas at a language-course registration where name, residence and telephone number are independently recombined.

story_continuity.evidence: Raha and Lena remain established acquaintances; Jonas is introduced only as a new course-office contact in the mastery context.

token_coverage.evidence: All 32 turns contain non-empty token arrays corresponding to clickable German surface words.

learner_speech_targets.evidence: All 16 learner turns include non-empty speech_target and at least two natural speech alternatives.

distractor_quality.evidence: All seven new words have three distinct related Persian distractors and none contains the recorded correct translation.

lesson_metadata.evidence: All four lessons contain non-empty German title/description and Persian translations, with explicit exposure, explicit_form, retrieval and mastery roles.
